race.comment: GIVE GIGGLES (3) has been far from disgraced at her last four runs, all in open company or stakes level. Last appeared at this level on ANZAC Day and scored over 1000m at this track. In the right race to return to the winner's enclosure. WITHOUT PARALLEL (16) has been freshened up since finishing powerfully to be beaten under a length over 1100m at Rosehill six weeks ago. Has raced here at this distance twice from a win and a placing. Good fresh performer who is right in contention. BOSSED UP (5) started favourite but was a bit flat-footed over 1110m at Doomben a fortnight ago, eventually getting up late for third. Better off back at 1200m so give him another chance. HELL (1) is back after a 21-week spell. Distance specialist who has a decent first-up record. Trialling like a horse that is ready to fly. POCKET FULL (8) is not without claims dropping back from open company last time out.
